lines.zh: 狼爪踩碎落叶，月下缓行。
lines.en: Paws crush the leaves as it walks under the moon.
It skirts the roots, keeping to the shadows.
It sits on a stump and looks up at the moon.

lines.zh: 原始森林的月光，照着我。
lines.en: Moonlight in the wildwood falls on me.

lines.zh: 月光下，我的眼睛是白的。
lines.en: Under the moon, my eyes are white.

lines.zh: 原始森林的月光照着我。
lines.en: Moonlight of the old forest is on me.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来了，腿好痛！

lines.en: Lightning struck and singed my fur.

lines.zh: 被扔进虚无里，快拉我出来！
被砍了一刀，它夹着尾巴退开。
lines.en: Cut by a blade, it tucks its tail and backs off.

lines.zh: 皎洁月光下，你成了我的猎物。
lines.en: In the bright moonlight, you're my prey.

lines.zh: 森林深处，你是我的食物。
lines.en: In the forest, you're my meal.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在落叶上沙沙作响。
lines.en: My paws make rustling sounds on the leaves.

lines.zh: 夜晚，我是这片森林的主宰。
lines.en: At night, I rule this forest.
Under the moonlight, you're no longer free.
In the moonlight, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 硬碰硬，我们的力量对等。

lines.en: You collide with my iron hooves.

lines.zh: 月光下，我捕捉你的影子。
lines.en: In the moonlight, I catch your shadow.

lines.zh: 我们之间的碰撞，异常激烈。
我们之间的碰撞，如同夜的回响。
lines.en: Our collision echoes like the night.
Under the moon, seek a mate.

lines.zh: 森林中，寻找我的另一半。
lines.en: In the forest, find my mate.

lines.zh: 月色朦胧，我是你的伴侣。

lines.en: In the moonlight, I seek love.

lines.zh: 原木森林，我的伴侣在此。
lines.en: Primeval forest, my mate is here.

lines.zh: 与月光一起，寻找我的灵魂伴侣。
lines.en: With the moonlight, seek my soulmate.
In the moonlight, I seek eternity.

lines.zh: 森林深处，我是你的伴侣。
lines.en: Deep in the forest, I am your mate.

lines.zh: 月光下的爱情，永不褪色。
森林的月光，见证我们的爱。
银色的月光映照着我的双眼。
森林中的月光是我的猎物。
lines.en: The forest’s moonlight guides my hunt.

lines.zh: 今晚，我要捕获我的晚餐。
月亮下，我的爪子更加锋利。
lines.en: Under the moon, my claws are sharper.
Prey, I shall taste your flesh.

lines.zh: 月光中，我的影子在移动。
lines.en: In the moonlight, my shadow moves.

lines.zh: 我的声音在月夜中回响。
lines.en: My voice echoes in the moonlit night.

lines.zh: 森林深处，月光下的猎手。
lines.en: In the forest, a hunter in the moonlight.
The moon is my only guide.
The howl in the moonlit night.
My sight locks on the prey.
The prey appears in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 月光下，我的牙齿更加锐利。
lines.en: My teeth are sharper in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我的猎物，在我的视野中。
lines.en: My prey is in my sight.

lines.zh: 月光下，我的狩猎本能觉醒。
lines.en: My hunting instinct awakens in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我的目标，就在森林深处。
lines.en: My target is deep in the forest.
The hunt in the moonlit night.
Its ears swivel; it heard you.
The wind shifted, and it scented you.
With two hundred health, it feels no hurry.
It eases out from behind a tree.
Its steps halt, aimed your way.
It decides you won't escape tonight.

lines.zh: 月光下，我的攻击更加致命。
lines.en: My attack is more deadly in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 猎物，我的牙齿即将触及你。
lines.en: Prey, my teeth are about to touch you.

lines.zh: 月光中，我的爪子要抓住你。
lines.en: In the moonlight, my claws grasp you.

lines.zh: 我的目标，就在我的爪下。
lines.en: My target is in my claws.
Under the moon, I end it.

lines.zh: 我的目标，在我的爪子之间。
lines.en: My target is between my claws.

lines.zh: 猎物，我的攻击就要到了。
月光下，我的猎物将无处可逃。
lines.en: In the moonlight, my prey has nowhere to run.

lines.zh: 我的目标，就在我的獠牙之间。
lines.en: My target is between my fangs.
It lowers its body, tail stiff.

lines.zh: 一爪只一点伤害，它不急。
lines.en: One claw does little damage, but it isn't rushed.
It circles, hunting for your opening.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的低吼压到最低。
lines.en: The growl in its throat drops to a whisper.

lines.zh: 月光把它的影子拉到你脚边。
lines.en: Moonlight stretches its shadow to your feet.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的膝盖，那里好咬。
lines.en: It eyes your knees; those bite well.
Its forepaw scrapes the dirt, ready to charge.
It needn't be fast, only you cannot rest.
In the tree shadows, it has changed its angle.
Step by step, it closes the gap.

lines.zh: 夜色中悄无声息地逼近。

lines.en: Moon wolf’s howl shakes the surroundings.

lines.zh: 一口咬住你的靴子不放。
lines.en: It clamps onto your boot and won't let go.

lines.zh: 狼爪在你护腿上刮出响声。
它撞过来，把你顶退一步。
lines.en: It slams into you and knocks you back a step.
This bite only broke the skin.
It knocks you down, then springs away.
It tears your cloak in frustration.
It rolls and bites your flank.

lines.zh: 呜咽一声也要咬第二口。
lines.en: With a whine, it still bites again.

lines.zh: 月光下，它的牙白得刺眼。
lines.en: In the moonlight, its teeth glare white.

lines.zh: 夜晚的原始森林守护者。
lines.en: Guardian of the original forest at night.
King of wolves under the moon.

lines.zh: 月之诅咒使它更加凶猛。
lines.en: Moon’s curse makes it more ferocious.
A howl rises in the primal forest.

lines.zh: 月亮一升，它就踏出树影。
lines.en: When the moon rises, it steps from the trees.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来了，腿好痛
被箭射到了，好疼，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Got hit by an arrow! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被扔进虚无里，快拉我出来
